cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from validate import validate
from adaptive2 import run_one

def build(n, period, dem, rate, npart):
    links=[[u,v,rate] for (u,v) in itertools.combinations(range(n),2)]
    k=min(n,npart)
    parts=[[v,dem] for v in range(k)]
    env=[[l,rate] for l in range(len(links))]
    cmds=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":links,"bookings":[]},
          {"op":"prepare","id":"p1","owner":"o","window":[0,period*2],"period":period,
           "participants":parts,"envelope":env,"rev":0}]
    return cmds

for (n, period, dem, rate, npart) in [(4,10,1,1,4),(5,10,2,2,5),(6,100,3,1,6),(8,100,2,1,8),(10,1000,1,1,10),(12,1000,2,2,12),(20,1000,1,1,10)]:
    cmds=build(n,period,dem,rate,npart)
    reps=run_one(cmds)
    problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
    r=reps[-1]
    kind=r.get('kind') or r.get('status')
    extra=''
    if r.get('status')=='prepared':
        extra=f" trees={len(r['plan']['trees'])} routes={len(r['plan']['routes'])} recipes={len(r['plan']['recipes'])}"
    print(f"n={n} per={period} dem={dem} rate={rate}: {r['status']}/{kind}{extra} problems={problems}")
PYEOF
